ImageDescription.value: A clump of tufted bulrush (Trichophorum caespitosum) shows the progression of fall color change in a muskeg near Sitka, Alaska. Muskegs, a colloquial term for peat bogs, blanket 10% of the Tongass National Forest. These wetlands range in size from a few square feet to many acres. Over the ages, muskegs formed as Sphagnum mosses, rushes and sedges grew and built up spongy carpets in these very wet, almost treeless areas. Photo by Mary Stensvold.

50592871.title: File:Myriophylles dans la Sèvre niortaise Aout 2016 F.Lamiot.jpg

ObjectName.value: Myriophylles dans la Sèvre niortaise Aout 2016 F.Lamiot

Categories.value: Self-published work|Freshwater underwater photographs of nature|Flora in the Sèvre niortaise

ImageDescription.value:
Elements of the underwater flora of the "Sèvre niortaise" river (France), here photographed in an area with mineral bio-encrustation (of algal or bacterial origin) in a shallow part and very well lit at a place called "Roman Bridge of Azay-le-Brûlé "(France).
There I observed several species of aquatic mosses (bryophytes), beautiful aquatic liver and vertical carpet of Marchantiophyta, water lilies with yellow flowers and a species of milfoil (Myriophyllum spicatum?) and (in August 2016) a few tufts of Lemna trisulca near the banks or trapped in branches or accumulations of outcropping rocks.

ImageDescription.value: Spenbrook Mill William Pownall & Sons Ltd, entering into carpet manufacturing in the pioneering days of the industry during the late 1950s, at Spenbrook Mill producing tufted carpet throughout the 1960s and 1970s and household textiles in Manchester. In 1995 a reconstruction and rationalisation program left the company centralised at Spenbrook Mill near Burnley in Lancashire, concentrating on carpet manufacturing.In 2006 Pownall Carpets left its rural mill at the foot of Pendle Hill near Burnley and joined its sister company Ryalux Carpets down the road in Bury and Rochdale, allowing further investment to be made in manufacturing and distribution facilities, thus continuing Pownall's tradition of offering high quality value carpets.
